# gcore_cloud_registry_artifacts (Data Source)



## Example Usage

```terraform
data "gcore_cloud_registry_artifacts" "example_cloud_registry_artifacts" {
  project_id = 1
  region_id = 1
  registry_id = 1
  repository_name = "nginx"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `registry_id` (Number) Registry ID
- `repository_name` (String) Repository name. If it contains a slash, encode it with URL encoding, e.g. a/b -> a%252Fb

### Optional

- `max_items` (Number) Max items to fetch, default: 1000
- `project_id` (Number) Project ID
- `region_id` (Number) Region ID

### Read-Only

- `items` (Attributes List) The items returned by the data source (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--items))

<a id="nestedatt--items"></a>
### Nested Schema for `items`

Read-Only:

- `digest` (String) Artifact digest
- `id` (Number) Repository ID
- `pulled_at` (String) Artifact last pull date-time
- `pushed_at` (String) Artifact push date-time
- `registry_id` (Number) Artifact registry ID
- `repository_id` (Number) Artifact repository ID
- `size` (Number) Artifact size, bytes
- `tags` (Attributes List) Artifact tags (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--items--tags))

<a id="nestedatt--items--tags"></a>
### Nested Schema for `items.tags`

Read-Only:

- `artifact_id` (Number) Artifact ID
- `id` (Number) Tag ID
- `name` (String) Tag name
- `pulled_at` (String) Tag last pull date-time
- `pushed_at` (String) Tag push date-time
- `repository_id` (Number) Repository ID
